userInputText: Suika Game is not for the faint of heart! This is a psychological horror experience that will test your genius strategy and a little bit of luck.Suika Game is one of the games that is taking the global gaming community by storm! This is not simply an intellectual game; this is also an enjoyable adventure where you will challenge your strategic abilities. Get ready to enter the world of Suika, where sweet watermelons are waiting for you to conquer!
